name: Spring Check
description: Animated checkbox with a spring-driven fill, drawn tick and a label that fades and gets struck through when checked. Works controlled or uncontrolled.
contents: Checkbox button with rounded box, ring, fill and drawn tick icon
behavior: Spring animation drives fill scale, box swell, tick draw, label fade and strike-through from one motion value
Press scales the box down to 0.95 on pointer down
Hover brightens the ring on fine-pointer devices
Keyboard toggles skip the animation and jump instantly
Reduced motion preference makes changes instant
editableByProps: Label text, aria label, checked state (controlled or default) and change handler
Text, ring, fill and tick colors
Box size, corner radius and font size
Spring bounce, strike delay, checked label opacity

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how much the box swells on overshoot
Change the strike line position or end point
needsCodeEdit.where: RULE_END constant and the ruleRef span className top-[46%]

fixed: Uses 'use client', so it only works in client-rendered React
Hover ring highlight only applies on devices with fine hover pointers
Touch row height is at least 44px
Uses a button with role checkbox, label is inline text only
Single checkbox only, no group handling
